purpose: Public provider manifest for Block10 route discovery. These providers receive no BTEN capability, treasury balance, keeper key, or browser private key.

providers.name: Aftermath Smart Order Router
providers.executionRule: Use its output only as a direct-route comparator. Protected BTEN routes must execute through the BTEN Move adapter.

providers.name: Hop Aggregator
providers.executionRule: Use its output only as a direct-route comparator. Do not construct or submit its transaction for a BTEN-gated route.

providers.name: 7K Aggregator
providers.scope: Quote comparison only after a stable @mysten/sui v2 compatible release is reviewed.
providers.gateRule: Never counts as a BTEN gated route without a separate audited protected adapter.

providers.name: FlowX Finance
providers.scope: Quote comparison only. The current published SDK brings legacy Sui v1 dependencies and is intentionally not included in BTEN.
providers.gateRule: Never counts as a BTEN gated route without a separate audited protected adapter.

providers.name: OKX Web3 DEX Router
providers.scope: Quote comparison only after a dedicated OKX Web3 API configuration is supplied.
providers.gateRule: Never counts as a BTEN gated route without a separate audited protected adapter.

providers.name: Router Nitro
providers.scope: User-initiated cross-chain bridge or swap only.
providers.gateRule: Never counts as a BTEN gated route. Cross-chain completion cannot be atomically proved by the current Sui BTEN package.

providers.name: YouSUI
providers.scope: User-initiated Sui swap or bridge only.
providers.gateRule: Never counts as a BTEN gated route unless a separate audited Sui-side protected adapter is built and deployed.

securityRules: The user's wallet signs every transaction.
No provider receives a BTEN admin capability, upgrade capability, treasury fund, or GitHub keeper secret.
A link or third-party quote is not evidence of a completed BTEN-gated route.
